scripts.build:lib: rm -rf dist && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json
scripts.build:grammar: antlr-ng -Dlanguage=TypeScript -l -v -o src/parser grammar/SqlBase.g4 && bun run fix:generated
scripts.fix:generated: sed -i 's|^import { ErrorNode, ParseTreeListener, ParserRuleContext, TerminalNode } from "antlr4ng";|import { ErrorNode, ParserRuleContext, TerminalNode } from "antlr4ng";\nimport type { ParseTreeListener } from "antlr4ng";|' src/parser/SqlBaseListener.ts
